source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary: Even after this **TRANSPORT** has made an [advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), units can [disembark](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) from it. A unit that does so is treated as if it made a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) in that phase, and it cannot declare a charge that turn, but otherwise acts as normal for the rest of the turn.
